title.zh: 卷三十一 本紀第三十一 高宗八
title.raw: 卷三十一 本紀第三十一 高宗八 Volume 31 Annals 31: Gaozong 8

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月癸卯，進韋淵太傅。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, spring, first month, day guimao: Wei Yuan was advanced to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 23, spring, guimao: Wei Yuan was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，復以李顯忠為甯國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Li Xianzhong was again made military commissioner of the Ningguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Li Xianzhong was restored as Ningguo Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，幸玉津園，遂幸延祥觀。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai: the Emperor visited Jade Ford Garden, then Extended Felicity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guihai: Gaozong visited Jade Ford Garden, then Extended Felicity Abbey.

sentences.zh: 庚午，臠虔州軍賊黃明等八人於都市。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Huang Ming and seven other bandits of the Ganzhou garrison were dismembered in the capital market.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Huang Ming and seven Ganzhou garrison rebels were quartered in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改虔州為贛州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Ganzhou was renamed Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Ganzhou was renamed Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，申嚴冒貫請舉法。

translations.literal: Day renshen: regulations against false claims for rewards were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the court tightened laws against fraudulent reward claims.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賞平贛盜功，以李耕為金州觀察使，將士進秩、給賞有差。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: those who pacified the Gan bandits were rewarded; Li Geng was made military observer of Jin prefecture; officers and soldiers received differing promotions and bounties.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, pacifiers of the Gan rebels were rewarded; Li Geng became Jin observer; troops were promoted and paid by merit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，詔諸州編管、羈管人，遵舊法，長吏月一驗視，不許囚禁。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: an edict ordered registered and restrained persons in all prefectures to follow the old law; chief officials were to inspect them monthly and were forbidden to imprison them.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinsi: registered and restrained persons were to follow old rules; prefects inspected them monthly and could not jail them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，減利州歲鑄錢為九萬緡。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Lizhou's yearly coin casting was reduced to ninety thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Lizhou's annual coin output was cut to ninety thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，禁州縣以私意籍罪人貲產。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: prefectures and counties were forbidden to register criminals' property at private discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengyin: counties could no longer seize convicts' property on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復以蕭振為四川制置使。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Xiao Zhen was again made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Xiao Zhen was again named Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金遣紇石烈大雅等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Jin sent Heshelie Daya and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Jin sent Heshelie Daya and others to greet the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，立淮南諸州舉人解額。

translations.literal: Day yimao: examination quotas for Presented Scholars in the Huainan prefectures were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Huainan prefectures received fixed Presented Scholar examination quotas.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，潼川大水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: Tongchuan suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yimao: Tongchuan was inundated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，寬理平江府、湖、秀二州被水民夏稅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: summer tax was eased for flood victims in Pingjiang prefecture and Hu and Xiu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renchen: summer tax was lightened for flood victims in Pingjiang, Hu, and Xiu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，從秦檜所請，命台州取綦崇禮草檜罷相制所受墨敕。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: at Qin Hui's request, Taizhou was ordered to recover the ink edict Qin Chongli had drafted for Hui's dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, at Qin Hui's request Taizhou was told to recover the dismissal edict Qin Chongli had drafted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁諸軍瀕太湖擅作壩田。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: all armies along Lake Tai were forbidden to build unauthorized dam fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, armies on Lake Tai were barred from building unauthorized dam fields.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，振潼川被水州縣，仍蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Tongchuan flood counties were relieved and their levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiawu: flood-struck Tongchuan counties were relieved and their taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禁采鹿胎。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the gathering of deer fetal pelts was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, collecting deer fetal pelts was banned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，詔郡守年七十者聽自陳，命主宮觀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi: an edict allowed prefects aged seventy to petition on their own behalf and be assigned to palace posts.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingsi: prefects of seventy might petition to retire to palace sinecures.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣吳㮚使金賀正旦，施鉅賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Wu Qi was sent as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Shi Ju to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Wu Qi was sent to the Jin for New Year's; Shi Ju for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宋樸罷。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Song Pu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Song Pu left office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以右諫議大夫史才簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Right Remonstrance Officer Shi Cai was made Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Shi Cai became Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣戶部郎官鐘世明修築宣州、太平州圩田。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Revenue Section officer Zhong Shiming was sent to build embankment fields in Xuan and Taiping prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhong Shiming was dispatched to build embankment farms in Xuan and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 是月，命大理鞫妖人孫士道獄。

translations.literal: That month, the Court of Judicial Review was ordered to try the sorcerer Sun Shidao.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Court of Judicial Review took up the sorcerer Sun Shidao.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，詔立張叔夜廟于信州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin: an edict ordered Zhang Shuye's temple built in Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renyin: Zhang Shuye's temple was ordered built in Xin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，班《大宗正司條令》。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Regulations of the Great Clan Directorate were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Great Clan Directorate regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以經筵終帙，賜宰執、講讀等官宴于秘書省，為故事。

translations.literal: Day yichou: because the classics lecture series had finished its volumes, the Grand Councilors, lecturers, and readers were banqueted at the Secretariat as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, with the lecture series complete, councilors and readers were feasted at the Secretariat by precedent.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，詔州縣稅額少者，罷其監官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: an edict abolished supervisory officials in prefectures with small tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingsi: supervisory posts were cut in low-tax prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，韋淵薨。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Wei Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wei Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，禁民車服逾制。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the people were forbidden to exceed regulations in carriage dress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, commoners were forbidden carriage dress beyond their rank.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，命檢正都司官詳定郡守所上利病以聞。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingshen: Rectification Bureau officials were ordered to review benefits and harms reported by prefects and submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingshen: Rectification Bureau officials were to vet prefects' reports of local ills and benefits.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命諸軍保任統制官在職十年無過者進秩。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: all armies were ordered to guarantee command officers who had served ten years without fault for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, armies were to vouch command officers of ten blameless years for promotion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金遣蔡松年等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Jin sent Cai Songnian and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Jin sent Cai Songnian and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，減池州青陽縣田租萬七千石。

translations.literal: That year, field rent in Qingyang county, Chizhou, was reduced by seventeen thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chizhou's Qingyang county lost seventeen thousand piculs of field rent.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月辛未，幸延祥觀。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: the Emperor visited Extended Felicity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 24, spring, xinwei: Gaozong visited Extended Felicity Abbey.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，初詔郡國同以八月十五日試舉人。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict first ordered all commanderies to hold the civil examination on the fifteenth of the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, every commandery was first told to examine candidates on the fifteenth of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封婉容劉氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Gentle Lady Liu was enfeoffed as Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Gentle Lady Liu was created Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，地震。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，前左從政郎楊炬坐其弟煒嘗上書誹謗，送邕州編管。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: former Left Policy Adviser Yang Ju was sentenced because his brother Wei had once submitted a slanderous memorial; he was sent to Yongzhou for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Yang Ju—his brother Wei had once sent a slanderous memorial—was sent to Yongzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加吳益太尉。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wu Yi was advanced to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wu Yi was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，楊再興復寇邊，前軍統制李道討平之，禽再興及其子正修、正拱，檻送行在。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: Yang Zaiying again raided the border; vanguard commander Li Dao suppressed him, capturing Zaiying and his sons Zhengxiu and Zhenggong and sending them to the capital in a cage.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renshen: Yang Zaiying raided again; Li Dao crushed him, caged Zaiying and sons Zhengxiu and Zhenggong, and sent them to court.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜禮部進士張孝祥以下三百五十六人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day yihai: three hundred fifty-six men including Ministry of Rites Presented Scholar Zhang Xiaoxiang were granted jinshi degrees and passes.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Xiaoxiang and 355 others received jinshi degrees and passes.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，秦檜以私憾捃摭知建康府王循友，詔大理鞫之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: because of private resentment Qin Hui gathered charges against Jiankang prefect Wang Xunyou; the Court of Judicial Review was ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Qin Hui—out of private spite—framed Jiankang prefect Wang Xunyou for trial.

sentences.zh: 是春，始榷夔州路茶。

translations.literal: That spring, the Kuizhou route tea monopoly was first imposed.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the court first monopolized tea on the Kuizhou route.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，詔諸路招補三衙諸軍，期三年課其殿最。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: an edict ordered all circuits to recruit for the Three Yamaz guards with a three-year term to rank their performance.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingxu: every circuit was to recruit for the Three Yamaz over three years and rank results.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，西南小張蕃貢方物。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the small Zhang tribe of the southwest presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the small Zhang tribe of the southwest sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，羅殿國貢名馬。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Luo Dian state presented famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Luo Dian presented famous horses.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou new moon: eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guichou new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 衢州民俞八作亂，圍州城，通判州事汪召錫拒卻之，遂掠嚴州壽昌縣，遣殿前司正將辛立討平之。

translations.literal: Quzhou commoner Yu Ba rebelled, besieged the prefectural city; acting prefect Wang Zhaoxi repulsed him; he then plundered Shouchang county in Yan prefecture; Palace Duty officer Xin Li was sent and suppressed the disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Quzhou's Yu Ba rebelled and besieged the city; Wang Zhaoxi drove him off; he looted Yan's Shouchang; Xin Li of the Palace Duty was sent and crushed him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，金遣耶律安禮等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the Jin sent Yelü Anli and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Jin sent Yelü Anli and others to greet the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，史才罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi: Shi Cai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guisi: Shi Cai left office.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以御史中丞魏師遜簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Censor-in-Chief Wei Shixun was made Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wei Shixun became Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王循友貸死、藤州安置。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Wang Xunyou was sentenced to commuted death and banished to Tengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wang Xunyou received commuted death and was sent to Tengzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔：「嘗命四川州縣減免財物，以寬民力，尚慮未周，令制置司、總領所同共措置，務在不妨軍食，可以裕民。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict said: "We once ordered Sichuan prefectures and counties to reduce levies to ease the people, yet fear it was not thorough; let the pacification office and overall commandery office jointly arrange matters, seeing to it that military provisions are not hindered and the people may be enriched.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, an edict said: "We once told Sichuan to cut levies for the people, yet it may not be enough; let pacification and overall command jointly plan so armies are fed and the people enriched.

sentences.zh: 」尋遣鐘世明如四川同議。

translations.literal: " Shortly after, Zhong Shiming was sent to Sichuan to deliberate together.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon Zhong Shiming was sent to Sichuan to consult on the plan.

sentences.zh: 以主管侍衛馬軍司成閔為慶遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Palace Horse Guard Cheng Min was made military commissioner of the Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Min, supervisor of the Palace Horse Guard, became Qingyuan Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，張俊薨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou: Zhang Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guichou: Zhang Jun died.

sentences.zh: 勒停人王趯坐交通李光，下大理獄。

translations.literal: The penalized man Wang Yue was charged with associating with Li Guang and sent to the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yue—already under penalty—was charged with ties to Li Guang and jailed for trial.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，臠徭人楊正修、正拱於市。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Yao men Yang Zhengxiu and Zhenggong were dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Yao captives Yang Zhengxiu and Zhenggong were quartered in the market.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復置邛、雅二州博易場三所。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: three Qiong and Ya prefecture trade depots were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, three Qiong and Ya trade depots were reopened.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔捐四川茶馬司羨餘錢給軍費，以寬民力。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered the surplus funds of the Sichuan Tea-and-Horse Office donated to military expenses to ease the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Sichuan Tea-and-Horse surpluses were ordered given to the army to lighten civilian burdens.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復落蕭振職、池州居住。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Xiao Zhen was again stripped of office and ordered to reside in Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Xiao Zhen was again dismissed and sent to Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以總領財賦符行中為四川制置使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: overall revenue chief Fu Xingzhong was made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Fu Xingzhong became Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，南丹州莫公晟及宜州界外諸蠻納土內附。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Mo Gongcheng of Nandan prefecture and various tribes beyond Yizhou submitted territory and came within the registers.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Nandan's Mo Gongcheng and tribes beyond Yizhou submitted land and allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸張俊第臨奠。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Emperor visited Zhang Jun's residence to mourn him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Gaozong went to Zhang Jun's house to mourn.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，禁百官避免輪對。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen: all officials were forbidden to avoid their turns at imperial audience.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renchen: officials could no longer skip their audience rotations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷溫州市黃柑、福州貢荔枝。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: tribute of Wenzhou golden oranges and Fuzhou lychees was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wenzhou oranges and Fuzhou lychees were struck from tribute lists.

sentences.zh: 丙午，追封張俊為循王。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhang Jun was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Jun was posthumously created Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 以湘潭縣丞鄭杞、主簿賈子展嘲毀朝政，除名，杞容州、子展德慶府編管。

translations.literal: Xiangtan county aide Zheng Qi and registrar Jia Zizhan were charged with mocking court policy; both were expelled from office; Qi was sent to Rongzhou and Zizhan to Deqing prefecture for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangtan aide Zheng Qi and registrar Jia Zizhan mocked policy; both were expelled—Qi to Rongzhou, Zizhan to Deqing under restraint.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥朔，李道如衡州措置盜賊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai new moon: Li Dao went to Hengzhou to handle bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinhai new moon: Li Dao went to Hengzhou to deal with bandits.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賞平衢賊功，升辛立領忠州團練使，將士遷職、給錢有差。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: those who pacified the Qu rebels were rewarded; Xin Li was advanced to regimental trainer of Zhong prefecture; officers and soldiers received differing promotions and cash.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Qu pacifiers were rewarded; Xin Li became Zhong regimental trainer; troops were promoted and paid by merit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，蠲旱傷州縣租賦。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu: rent and tax were remitted in drought-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renwu: rent was forgiven in drought-hit counties.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣沈虛中使金賀正旦，張士襄賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Shen Xuzhong was sent as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Zhang Shixiang to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Shen Xuzhong went to the Jin for New Year's; Zhang Shixiang for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，魏師遜罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Wei Shixun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yichou: Wei Shixun left office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以權吏部侍郎施钜參知政事，鄭仲熊簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: acting Ministry of Personnel Vice Minister Shi Ju was made Vice Grand Councilor; Zheng Zhongxiong Privy Council Signatory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Shi Ju became Vice Grand Councilor; Zheng Zhongxiong Privy Council Signatory.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，進秦熺少傅，封嘉國公。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Qin Xi was advanced to Junior Tutor and enfeoffed Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Qin Xi was made Junior Tutor and Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 是月，以通判武岡軍方疇通書胡銓及他罪，除名、永州編管。

translations.literal: That month, acting Wugang prefect Fang Chou was expelled for sending letters to Hu Quan and other crimes; he was banished to Yongzhou under restraint.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang Chou of Wugang was expelled for writing Hu Quan and other crimes and sent to Yongzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，以故龍圖閣學士程瑀有《論語講解》，秦檜疑其譏己，知饒州洪興祖嘗為序，京西轉運副使魏安行鏤版，至是命毀之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: because the late Academician Cheng Yu had a Commentary on the Analects that Qin Hui suspected mocked him, and Raozhou prefect Hong Xingzu had once written its preface while Jingxi transport vice commissioner Wei Anxing had carved the blocks—an order was issued to destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingxu: Cheng Yu's Analects commentary—Qin Hui thought it mocked him—was ordered destroyed, with Hong Xingzu's preface and Wei Anxing's printing blocks.

sentences.zh: 興祖昭州、安行欽州編管，瑀子孫亦論罪。

translations.literal: Xingzu was sent to Zhaozhou and Anxing to Qinzhou for registered restraint; Cheng Yu's sons and grandsons were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzu went to Zhaozhou, Anxing to Qinzhou under restraint; Cheng Yu's kin were punished too.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王趯除名、辰州編管。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wang Yue was expelled from office and sent to Chenzhou for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Yue was expelled and sent to Chenzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，知鄞縣程緯為其丞王肇所告，慢上無人臣禮，除名、貴州編管，籍其貲。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Yin county prefect Cheng Wei was reported by his aide Wang Zhao for disrespect to superiors and lack of ministerial propriety; he was expelled, sent to Guizhou under restraint, and his property registered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yin prefect Cheng Wei was reported by aide Wang Zhao for insolence; expelled, sent to Guizhou under restraint, property seized.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，刺諸路編管人充廂軍。

translations.literal: Day renyin: registered persons on all circuits were impressed into the garrison service.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, registered persons on every circuit were drafted into garrison service.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金遣白彥恭等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Jin sent Bai Yangong and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Jin sent Bai Yangong and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月辛未，賞討楊再興功，保甯軍承宣使李道落階官，加龍神衛四廂都指揮使，將士進官、賜錢有差。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: those who suppressed Yang Zaiying were rewarded; Pacification Army commissioner Li Dao lost his rank title and was made commander of the four wings of the Dragon Spirit Guard; officers and soldiers received differing promotions and cash.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 25, spring, xinwei: Yang Zaiying's suppressors were rewarded; Li Dao of the Pacification Army lost rank but became Dragon Spirit Guard commander; troops were paid by merit.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，以鎮江都統制劉寶為安慶軍節度使，建康都統制王權為清遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: Zhenjiang commander Liu Bao was made Anqing Army military commissioner; Jiankang commander Wang Quan Qingyuan Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiyou: Liu Bao of Zhenjiang became Anqing commissioner; Wang Quan of Jiankang became Qingyuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以通判常州沈長卿、仁和縣尉芮燁作詩譏訕，除名，長卿化州、燁武岡軍編管。

translations.literal: Day renyin: acting Changzhou prefect Shen Changqing and Renhe county sheriff Rui Ye were charged with composing poems that sneered; both were expelled; Changqing to Huazhou and Ye to Wugang under restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Shen Changqing of Changzhou and Rui Ye of Renhe were expelled for sneering verse—Changqing to Huazhou, Ye to Wugang under restraint.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，右司郎中張士襄自金國使還，坐奉使不肅罷官。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou: Right Bureau officer Zhang Shixiang returned from the Jin mission and was dismissed for lack of decorum on embassy duty.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiyou: Zhang Shixiang returned from the Jin and was dismissed for undignified conduct on mission.

sentences.zh: 壬申，地震。

translations.literal: Day renshen: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，施鉅罷，以鄭仲熊兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: Shi Ju was dismissed; Zheng Zhongxiong was made acting Vice Grand Councilor as well.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yiyou: Shi Ju left office; Zheng Zhongxiong also became acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命四川制置司許就類省試院校試刑法。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the Sichuan pacification office was permitted to hold a classified provincial examination in penal law at the examination yard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Sichuan pacification was allowed a classified provincial exam in penal law.

sentences.zh: 己亥，減廣西路折米錢。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Guangxi route's rice-conversion levy was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Guangxi's rice-conversion levy was cut.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei new moon: eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingwei new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 太廟仁宗室柱生芝九莖。

translations.literal: In the Renzong chamber of the Imperial Ancestral Temple a pillar sprouted nine stalks of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Nine lingzhi stalks sprouted on a pillar in the Renzong spirit chamber.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷諸路免行錢歲百八萬緡。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the exemption-fee levy of 1.08 million strings yearly on all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the yearly 1.08-million-string exemption fee on all circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前知泉州宗室令衿譏訕秦檜，遂坐交結罪人、汀州居住。

translations.literal: Day guichou: former Quanzhou prefect, clansman Ling Qin, was charged with sneering at Qin Hui and sentenced for associating with criminals; he was sent to Tingzhou for registered residence.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, clansman Ling Qin—former Quanzhou prefect—was punished for mocking Qin Hui and sent to Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，金遣李通等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Jin sent Li Tong and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Jin sent Li Tong and others to greet the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜劉錡湖南田百頃。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Liu Qi was granted one hundred qing of fields in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Liu Qi received one hundred qing of Hunan farmland.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，鄭仲熊罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: Zheng Zhongxiong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengchen: Zheng Zhongxiong left office.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以禮部侍郎湯思退簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Ministry of Rites Vice Minister Tang Situi was made Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Tang Situi became Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以言者追譖岳飛，改岳州為純州，岳陽軍為華容軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: because of memorialists' renewed slanders against Yue Fei, Yue prefecture was renamed Chun prefecture and Yueyang Army Huarong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, after memorialists again slandered Yue Fei, Yue prefecture became Chun and Yueyang Army Huarong Army.

sentences.zh: 是月，安南入貢。

translations.literal: That month, Annan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Annan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，減四川絹估、稅斛、鹽酒等錢歲百六十余萬緡，蠲州縣積欠二百九十余萬緡。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: Sichuan's silk valuation, tax grain, salt, and wine levies were reduced by more than 1.6 million strings yearly; accumulated arrears in prefectures and counties of more than 2.9 million strings were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingchen: Sichuan silk, grain, salt, and wine levies fell over 1.6 million strings yearly; 2.9 million in arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 詔四川營田有占民田者，常平司按驗給還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that where Sichuan military colonies occupied civilian fields, the Ever-Normal Granary office was to verify and return them.
translations.idiomatic: Where Sichuan garrison farms had seized civilian land, the Ever-Normal office was to verify and restore it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，封李天祚為南平王。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Li Tianzuo was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Li Tianzuo was created Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，申嚴誣告加等法。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: regulations against false accusation with aggravated penalties were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingchou: false-accusation laws with heavier penalties were tightened.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命大理鞫趙汾及令衿交通獄。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Court of Judicial Review was ordered to try Zhao Fen and Ling Qin for associating with each other.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the court was told to try Zhao Fen and Ling Qin for collusion.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以吏部侍郎董德元參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Ministry of Personnel Vice Minister Dong Deyuan was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Dong Deyuan became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 蠲諸路身丁、免丁錢一年。

translations.literal: The head-tax and exemption head-tax levies on all circuits were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Head-tax and exemption head-tax on all circuits were forgiven for one year.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，建執政府。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Chief Councilors' office was built.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Chief Councilors' hall was erected.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，秦檜上《紹興寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi: Qin Hui presented the Shaoxing Clemency Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingsi: Qin Hui submitted the Shaoxing Clemency Edicts.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳朔，追封檜申王，諡忠獻，賜神道碑，額為「決策元功，精忠全德」。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi new moon: Hui was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shen, canonically titled Zhongxian, granted a spirit-way stele inscribed "Founding strategist, whole in loyalty and virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yisi new moon: Hui was posthumously Prince of Shen, styled Zhongxian, with a spirit stele reading "Founding strategist, whole in loyalty and virtue."

sentences.zh: 戊申，奪趙汾二官。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhao Fen was stripped of two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhao Fen lost two ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以敷文閣直學士魏良臣參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Academician Wei Liangchen was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wei Liangchen became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Circular Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Circular Mound and a great amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸秦檜第臨奠。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Emperor visited Qin Hui's residence to mourn him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Gaozong went to Qin Hui's house to mourn.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復洪皓官，釋張祁獄。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Hong Hao's office was restored and Zhang Qi's imprisonment released.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hong Hao's post was restored and Zhang Qi freed from prison.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷大理寺官旬白。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Court of Judicial Review's ten-day reporting rule was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Court of Judicial Review's ten-day reporting cycle was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔監司、郡守，事無巨細，皆須奏聞裁決，毋得止上尚書省。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict ordered surveillance commissioners and prefects that matters great or small must all be memorialized for imperial decision and must not stop at the Three Departments alone.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, intendants and prefects were told every matter, great or small, must reach the throne—not stop at the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 臣僚薦舉人才，必三人以上同薦。

translations.literal: When officials recommended talent, no fewer than three had to recommend jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Official recommendations of talent required at least three joint sponsors.

sentences.zh: 封叔和州防禦使、右監門衛大將軍士俴為崇慶軍節度使、嗣濮王，福建路提刑令詪為利州觀察使、安定郡王。

translations.literal: Clansman, Hezhou defense commissioner and Right Gate Guard senior general Shi Yan was enfeoffed Chongqing Army military commissioner and Heir of the Prince of Pu; Fujian-route judicial commissioner Ling Qian was made Lizhou military observer and Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Clansman Shi Yan—Hezhou defender and Right Gate Guard general—became Chongqing commissioner and Heir of Pu; Ling Qian of Fujian became Lizhou observer and Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 辛未，知建康府王會及列郡守臣王晌、王鑄、鄭僑年、鄭震、方滋俱以諂附貪冒罷。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Jiankang prefect Wang Hui and the column of prefects Wang Shang, Wang Zhu, Zheng Qiaonian, Zheng Zhen, and Fang Zi were all dismissed for fawning, attachment, and greed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wang Hui of Jiankang and prefects Wang Shang, Wang Zhu, Zheng Qiaonian, Zheng Zhen, and Fang Zi were dismissed for flattery and graft.

sentences.zh: 真臘、羅斛國貢馴象。

translations.literal: Zhenla and the Luo Hu states presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenla and Luo Hu sent tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌朔，詔曰：「台諫風憲之地，比用非其人，党于大臣，濟其喜怒，殊非耳目之寄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu new moon: an edict said: "The censorate and remonstrance bureau are posts of wind and law; lately unworthy men have been used, banding with great ministers to serve their tempers—far from the eyes and ears we entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiaxu new moon: an edict said: "Censors and remonstrators guard the law; lately unworthy men banded with ministers to serve their moods—not the eyes and ears we wanted.

sentences.zh: 朕今親除公正之士，以革前弊。

translations.literal: We now personally appoint upright men to reform past abuses.
translations.idiomatic: We now personally appoint upright men to end past abuses.

sentences.zh: 繼此者宜盡心乃職，毋合黨締交，敗亂成法，當謹茲戒，毋自貽咎。

translations.literal: Those who follow should devote themselves to duty, must not form factions or alliances, or ruin standing law; heed this warning and do not bring ruin on yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: Successors must serve faithfully, form no factions, and not wreck the law; heed this or invite your own ruin.

sentences.zh: 」詔張浚、折彥質、万俟禼、段拂聽自便。

translations.literal: " An edict allowed Zhang Jun, Zhe Yanzhi, Moqi Xi, and Duan Fu to do as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Jun, Zhe Yanzhi, Moqi Xi, and Duan Fu were told they might act as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 量移李光郴州安置。

translations.literal: Li Guang was transferred to Chenzhou for registered residence.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guang was moved to Chenzhou for registered residence.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復以禼為資政殿學士，提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Moqi Xi was again made Academician and charged with the Longevity Abbey while serving as Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Moqi Xi was again Academician, charged with Longevity Abbey, and made Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，鄭億年責建武軍節度副使、南安軍安置。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Zheng Yinian was demoted to Jianwu Army vice commissioner and sent to Nan'an Army for registered residence.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zheng Yinian was demoted to Jianwu vice commissioner and sent to Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔監司、守臣禁羨余，罷權攝，戢苞苴，節宴飲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered surveillance commissioners and prefects to forbid surpluses, abolish acting appointments, curb gifts, and limit banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Intendants and prefects were told to end surpluses, stop acting posts, curb gifts, and limit feasts.

sentences.zh: 詔前後告訐者莫汲、汪召錫、陸升之等九人除名，廣南諸州編管。

translations.literal: An edict expelled from office and sent to Guangnan circuits for registered restraint the nine men including Mo Ji, Wang Zhaoxi, and Lu Shengzhi who had informed on others before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Ji, Wang Zhaoxi, Lu Shengzhi, and six other informers were expelled and sent to Guangnan under restraint.

sentences.zh: 甲申，召孟忠厚奉朝請。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Meng Zhonghou was summoned to attend court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Meng Zhonghou was recalled to court audience.

sentences.zh: 命胡寅、張九成等二十八人並令自便，仍復其官。

translations.literal: Hu Yin, Zhang Jiucheng, and twenty-eight others were all ordered to do as they pleased and had their offices restored.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yin, Zhang Jiucheng, and twenty-eight others were freed to act as they pleased and restored to office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，董德元罷。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Dong Deyuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Dong Deyuan left office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以劉錡知潭州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Liu Qi was made prefect of Tan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Liu Qi became prefect of Tan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命三省、六部條具續降敕旨來上，審詳施行。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Three Departments and Six Ministries were ordered to list continued supplementary edicts for submission, review, and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Three Departments and Six Ministries were to list new supplementary edicts for review and execution.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以敷文閣待制沈該參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Academician Awaiting Orders Shen Gai was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Shen Gai became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以王會恃權貪橫，停官、循州編管。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: because Wang Hui had abused power and been greedy and overbearing, he was suspended from office and sent to Xunzhou for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wang Hui—who had abused power and grown greedy—was suspended and sent to Xunzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復以蕭振為四川制置使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Xiao Zhen was again made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xiao Zhen was again named Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 復張浚、折彥質、趙汾、葉三省、王ＡＺ、劉岑官。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun, Zhe Yanzhi, Zhao Fen, Ye Sansheng, Wang Yuan, and Liu Qin had their offices restored.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, Zhe Yanzhi, Zhao Fen, Ye Sansheng, Wang Yuan, and Liu Qin were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 移胡銓衡州。

translations.literal: Hu Quan was transferred to Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan was moved to Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁閩、浙、川、廣貢真珠、文犀。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: tribute of real pearls and horned rhinoceros from Fujian, Zhe, Sichuan, and Guang was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Fujian, Zhe, Sichuan, and Guang were forbidden to send pearls and rhinoceros horn as tribute.

sentences.zh: 戒州縣加收耗糧。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were admonished against collecting extra wastage grain.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were warned against extra wastage surcharges on grain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，金遣耶律歸一等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Jin sent Yelü Guiyi and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Jin sent Yelü Guiyi and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月壬子，省諸州稅場，以寬商賈。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, day renzi: tax depots in the prefectures were reduced to ease merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 26, spring, renzi: prefectural tax depots were cut to ease merchants.

sentences.zh: 甲子，追復趙鼎、孫近、鄭剛中、汪藻舊職。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Zhao Ding, Sun Jin, Zheng Gangzhong, and Wang Zao had their former offices posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhao Ding, Sun Jin, Zheng Gangzhong, and Wang Zao were posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔選擇監司，須七品以上清望官，或經朝擢及治郡著績者。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict ordered selection of surveillance commissioners from seventh-rank and above men of clear reputation, or those promoted at court or with distinguished prefectural records.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, intendants were to be seventh-rank men of reputation, court favorites, or proven prefects.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，曹泳吉陽軍編管。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Cao Yong was sent to Jiyang Army for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Cao Yong was sent to Jiyang Army under restraint.

sentences.zh: 封伯令衿明州觀察使、安定郡王，以其從弟令詪讓也。

translations.literal: Clansman Ling Qin was enfeoffed Mingzhou military observer and Prince of Anding, as his younger cousin Ling Qian yielded.
translations.idiomatic: Clansman Ling Qin became Mingzhou observer and Prince of Anding when cousin Ling Qian yielded.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，除民事律。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the civil statutes on common affairs were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the civil statutes on common affairs were issued.

sentences.zh: 蠲諸路積負及黃河竹索錢。

translations.literal: Accumulated arrears on all circuits and Yellow River bamboo-rope charges were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears on all circuits and Yellow River rope charges were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，命四川州縣，凡預借民賦稅分限理析。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai: an edict ordered Sichuan prefectures and counties to set limits on advance collection of civilian taxes and rents.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: Sichuan was told to cap advance collection of civilian taxes and rents.

sentences.zh: 己卯，定諸州流寓士人解額。

translations.literal: Day jimao: examination quotas for sojourning scholars in the prefectures were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, examination quotas for sojourning scholars were set by prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷進奏院定本朝報。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Memorial Transmission Office's fixed court gazette was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Memorial Transmission Office's fixed court gazette was ended.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，進士林東追諂秦檜，上書狂妄，英州編管。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Presented Scholar Lin Dong, who had fawned on Qin Hui with reckless memorials, was sent to Yingzhou for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Presented Scholar Lin Dong—who had fawned on Qin Hui with reckless memorials—was sent to Yingzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 右朝奉郎林一飛坐指使林東，責監高州鹽稅。

translations.literal: Right Court Gentleman Lin Yifei was charged with directing Lin Dong and was demoted to supervise Gaozhou salt tax.
translations.idiomatic: Right Court Gentleman Lin Yifei, charged with directing Lin Dong, was demoted to supervise Gaozhou salt tax.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，三佛齊國入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Sanfoqi state sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Sanfoqi presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，魏良臣罷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Wei Liangchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wei Liangchen left office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以左朝散大夫王曮為秦檜親黨，直徽猷閣呂願中貪虐附檜，曮建昌軍居住，願中責果州團練副使、封州安置。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Left Court Gentleman-for-Attendance Wang Yan, as Qin Hui's kin, and Direct Academician Lü Yuanzhong, greedy and cruel in attachment to Hui, were sent to Jianchang Army and demoted to Guo prefecture regimental vice trainer at Fengzhou, respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Yan—Qin Hui's kin—and Lü Yuanzhong, who had been greedy in Hui's service, were sent to Jianchang and demoted to Fengzhou regimental vice trainer.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，以邊事已定，罷宰相兼領樞密使。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: because the frontier was settled, the chancellor's concurrent charge as Commissioner of the Privy Council was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiayin: with the frontier settled, the chancellor ceased to head the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔兩淮邊民未復業者，復其租十年。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict remitted ten years of rent for Huainan frontier people not yet returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huainan frontier folk not yet home received ten years' rent forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己未，以万俟禼參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Moqi Xi was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Moqi Xi became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加吳璘開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Wu Lin was advanced to Grand Preceptor with the ceremony of opening an office of equal rank to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wu Lin was made Grand Preceptor with equal ceremonial rank to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以東平府進士梁勳伏闕上書言北事，送千里外州軍編管。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Presented Scholar Liang Xun of Dongping, who had knelt at the palace gate to memorialize on northern affairs, was sent to a prefecture or army a thousand li away for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liang Xun of Dongping—who had knelt at the gate to speak on the north—was banished a thousand li under restraint.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「講和之策，斷自朕志，秦檜但能贊朕而已，豈以其存亡而渝定議耶？

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict said: "The policy of peace was decided by Our will alone; Qin Hui could only assist Us—how could its survival or death alter a settled decision?
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, an edict said: "Peace was Our decision alone; Qin Hui only aided Us—how could his life or death change what was settled?

sentences.zh: 近者無知之輩，鼓倡浮言，以惑眾聽，至有偽撰詔命，召用舊臣，抗章公車，妄議邊事，朕甚駭之。

translations.literal: Lately ignorant men have drummed up empty talk to confuse listeners, even forging edicts to recall old ministers, submitting memorials at the public carriage, and recklessly debating frontier affairs—We are deeply alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Lately ignorant men have spread empty talk, forged edicts to recall old ministers, petitioned at the gate, and debated the frontier—We are deeply alarmed.

sentences.zh: 自今有此，當重置典憲。

translations.literal: From now on, whoever does this shall face the heaviest penalties of law.
translations.idiomatic: From now on such acts will face the law's heaviest penalties.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，蠲閩、浙諸州歲供軍器所物料三之一，減諸州工匠千人。

translations.literal: " Day dingmao: the yearly third of materials supplied from Fujian and Zhe to the Arsenal was remitted; craftsmen in the prefectures were reduced by a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao, a third of Fujian and Zhe Arsenal materials was forgiven and a thousand prefectural craftsmen cut.

sentences.zh: 己巳，募四川民佃淮南、京西閒田，並邊復租稅十年，次邊五年。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Sichuan commoners were recruited to farm idle fields in Huainan and Jingxi; on the frontier rent was remitted ten years, in the next zone five.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Sichuan farmers were recruited for Huainan and Jingxi idle land; frontier rent was forgiven ten years, the next belt five.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，增溫、台等十六州解額。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: examination quotas were increased in sixteen prefectures including Wen and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi: examination quotas rose in sixteen prefectures including Wen and Tai.

sentences.zh: 命湖北路以增戶、墾田為守令殿最。

translations.literal: The Hubei route was ordered to rank prefects and magistrates by household growth and reclaimed fields.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei was told to rank prefects and magistrates by new households and reclaimed land.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣陳誠之等賀金主尊號禮成。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Chen Chengzhi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on completion of his honorific title rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Chen Chengzhi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's honorific rites.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，置武學官及弟子員百人。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Military Studies posts and a hundred student places were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Military Studies offices and a hundred student places were created.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禁州郡進祥瑞。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: prefectures and commanderies were forbidden to present auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, prefectures were forbidden to present auspicious portents.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立六科以舉士。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: six categories for recommending scholars were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, six categories for recommending scholars were set.

sentences.zh: 加韋謙太尉。

translations.literal: Wei Qian was advanced to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qian was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 詔大辟情犯無可矜憫者，禁刑、寺妄引例奏裁貸減。

translations.literal: An edict forbade the penal offices from citing precedents to memorialize for mercy or reduction in capital cases where the circumstances admitted no pity.
translations.idiomatic: Capital cases without pity were forbidden mercy petitions citing precedent from the penal offices.

sentences.zh: 罷鄉飲酒舉士法。

translations.literal: The village-wine recommendation method for selecting scholars was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting scholars through village-wine recommendation was ended.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南、京西占射官田逾二年未盡墾者，募人更佃。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that where Huainan and Jingxi allotted official fields beyond two years were not fully reclaimed, men were to be recruited to farm them anew.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan and Jingxi allotted fields unreclaimed after two years were to be leased anew.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，以沈該為尚書左僕射，万俟禼為右僕射，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: Shen Gai was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Moqi Xi Right Vice Director, both Grand Councilors of the Tongzhongshu Menxia Pingzhangshi rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renyin: Shen Gai became Left Vice Director and Moqi Xi Right Vice Director, both Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 湯思退知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Tang Situi was made Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi became Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔州軍教授毋兼他職。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict forbade prefectural and army instructors from holding other posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, prefectural and army instructors could not hold other posts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，蠲楚州、盱眙軍民租十年。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: rent for the people of Chuzhou and Xuyi Army was remitted for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chuzhou and Xuyi Army rent was forgiven ten years.

sentences.zh: 己未，金遣敬嗣暉等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Jin sent Jing Sihui and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Jin sent Jing Sihui and others to greet the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未朔，罷諸路鬻戶絕田。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei new moon: the sale of heirless fields on all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinwei new moon: sale of heirless fields on all circuits was ended.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以端明殿學士程克俊參知政事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Academician Cheng Kejun was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Cheng Kejun became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復權要親族中第覆試法。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the supplementary examination for relatives of powerful families who passed the primary test was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the make-up exam for powerful families' kin who passed the primary test was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔取士毋拘程頤、王安石一家之說。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict ordered that in selecting scholars one must not be bound to the teachings of Cheng Yi or Wang Anshi alone.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, scholar selection was not to be bound to Cheng Yi or Wang Anshi alone.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以秦檜既死，命史館重修日曆。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because Qin Hui had died, the Historiography Office was ordered to revise the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with Qin Hui dead, the Historiography Office was told to revise the calendar.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，詔三衙主帥舉武臣堪知州者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: an edict ordered the Three Yamaz commanders to recommend military men fit to govern prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinchou: Three Yamaz commanders were to recommend military men fit for prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蠲諸路丁絹一年為二十四萬匹。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the head-tax silk levy on all circuits was remitted for one year, twenty-four thousand bolts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the yearly head-tax silk of twenty-four thousand bolts was forgiven on all circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙午，右奉議郎薛仲邕連州編管。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Right Policy Adviser Xue Zhongyong was sent to Lianzhou for registered restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xue Zhongyong was sent to Lianzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 丁未，彗出井，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: a comet appeared in the Well constellation; the Emperor left the hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a comet rose in the Well; Gaozong left the hall and cut his meals.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諸州守貳考各縣丁籍，依年格收除。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: an edict ordered prefectural deputies to audit household registers in each county and collect or remove levies by yearly quota.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, prefectural deputies were to audit county household registers and levy by yearly quota.

sentences.zh: 民間市物，官戶、勢家與編氓均科。

translations.literal: In common market purchases, official households and powerful families were to be assessed equally with registered commoners.
translations.idiomatic: In market purchases, official and powerful households were assessed like commoners.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，彗滅。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 詔進士因事送諸州軍聽讀，特放逐便，仍許取應。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that jinshi sent to prefectures and armies to study because of offenses might return at special discretion and still be allowed to take examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi banished to study in the provinces might return at discretion and still sit examinations.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，雨水銀。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: rain fell as liquid silver.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, rain fell as liquid silver.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，班元豐、崇甯學制于諸路。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: the Yuanfeng and Chongning school systems were promulgated to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: Yuanfeng and Chongning school regulations were issued to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 革正前舉登第奏塤、曹冠等九人出身，以淮南提舉常平朱冠卿言，秦檜挾私廢法，塤等皆其子孫、親戚、門下憸人，於是有官應試者，所授階官易左為右，白身者駁放。

translations.literal: The degrees of the nine men who had earlier passed and received jinshi status—Qin Sun, Cao Guan, and others—were corrected. On the word of Huainan Ever-Normal intendant Zhu Guanqing, Qin Hui had bent the law for private ends; Sun and the rest were all his grandsons, kin, and sycophantic followers. Those with office who had tested had their granted rank titles changed from left to right; those without office were rejected and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Degrees were corrected for nine recent jinshi, including Qin Sun and Cao Guan. Zhu Guanqing, Huainan Ever-Normal intendant, said Qin Hui had bent the law for kin: Sun and the rest were grandsons, relatives, or hangers-on. Officials who had tested had rank titles downgraded from left to right; commoners were failed and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 佔用省額，復還後科。

translations.literal: Quotas they had occupied were restored to the next examination.
translations.idiomatic: Examination quotas they had taken were returned for the next round.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，裁州縣吏額。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: prefectural and county clerical quotas were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, prefectural and county clerk quotas were reduced.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蠲建康府積欠內帑錢帛。

translations.literal: Day jichou: accumulated arrears owed the inner treasury in Jiankang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Jiankang's piled-up inner-treasury debt was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，安南國遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Annam sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Annam sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，程克俊罷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Cheng Kejun left office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Cheng Kejun left office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以吏部侍郎張綱參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Gang was made Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhang Gang of Personnel became Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，以翰林學士陳誠之同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi: Hanlin academician Chen Chengzhi was made Associate Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi: Hanlin academician Chen Chengzhi became Associate Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，立互易薦舉坐罪法。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: a mutual-recommendation exchange law with penalties was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, a law penalizing swapped recommendations was enacted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔成都、潼川兩路漕臣同制置、總領、茶馬司審度四川財賦利害，其實惠得以及民、調度可以經久者，條具以聞。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict ordered the transport commissioners of Chengdu and Tongchuan, together with the pacification, overall finance, and tea-horse offices, to review Sichuan revenue and expenditure. Whatever truly benefited the people and could be sustained long-term was to be listed and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chengdu and Tongchuan transport chiefs, with pacification, overall finance, and tea-horse offices, were to review Sichuan finances and report measures that truly helped the people and could last.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以天聖、紹興真決贓吏指揮班示諸路。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: directives on true verdicts for corrupt officials under the Tiansheng and Shaoxing reigns were promulgated to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Tiansheng and Shaoxing rules on convicting corrupt officials were sent to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，增大理寺吏祿。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: clerical salaries in the Court of Judicial Review were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Court of Judicial Review clerks received higher salaries.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命吏、刑二部修條例為成法。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Ministries of Personnel and Justice were ordered to revise regulations into standing law.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Personnel and Justice were told to codify regulations as permanent law.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳朔，詔許秦檜在位之日，無辜被罪者自陳厘正。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jisi new moon: an edict allowed those unjustly punished during Qin Hui's tenure to petition for correction.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jisi new moon: victims of wrongful punishment under Qin Hui could petition for redress.

sentences.zh: 罷浙東常平司平准務。

translations.literal: The Zhe East Ever-Normal price-stabilization office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhe East Ever-Normal price-stabilization office was shut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔四川監司、帥臣、制置、總領、茶馬司，各舉可守郡者。

translations.literal: Day yihai: an edict ordered Sichuan circuit supervisors, commanders, pacification commissioners, overall finance chiefs, and tea-horse offices each to recommend men fit to hold prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Sichuan overseers, commanders, pacifiers, finance chiefs, and tea-horse chiefs were each to recommend fit prefects.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蠲郴、道、永三州、桂陽軍民身丁米。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: personal head-rice tax was remitted for Chen, Dao, Yong prefectures and Guiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, head-rice tax was forgiven for Chen, Dao, Yong, and Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，王會移瓊州編管。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Wang Hui was transferred to registered restraint at Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wang Hui was sent to Qiongzhou under restraint.

sentences.zh: 以宋貺党附秦檜，責梅州安置。

translations.literal: Song Dang, for siding with Qin Hui, was ordered to reside at Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song Dang, a Qin partisan, was banished to Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以張浚上書論用兵，依舊永州居住。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: because Zhang Jun had memorialized on using troops, he was again made to reside at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhang Jun's memorial on warfare sent him back to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑。

translations.literal: Day xinchou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou:

sentences.zh: 遣李琳使金賀正旦，葛立方賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Li Lin was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's; Ge Lifang was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lin went to the Jin for New Year's; Ge Lifang for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，罷廉州貢珠，縱蛋丁自便。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingwu: Lianzhou's pearl tribute was ended and egg collectors were freed to go as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingwu: Lianzhou pearl tribute ended and pearl divers were freed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命離軍人願歸農者，人給江、淮、湖、廣荒田百畝，復其租稅十年。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: discharged soldiers who wished to return to farming were each given one hundred mu of wasteland in Jiang, Huai, lakes, and Guang circuits, with ten years' tax remission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, discharged soldiers who chose farming received one hundred mu of wasteland on Jiang, Huai, lake, and Guang routes, tax-free for ten years.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，初置臨安府左、右廂官，分掌訟牒。

translations.literal: Day yimao: left and right ward officials of Lin'an were first appointed to handle lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Lin'an first gained left and right ward officers to handle suits.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，命吏部侍郎陳康伯、戶部侍郎王俁稽考國用歲中出納之數。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: Vice Ministers of Personnel Chen Kangbo and Revenue Wang Yi were ordered to audit the year's national income and outlay.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu: Chen Kangbo of Personnel and Wang Yi of Revenue were told to audit yearly revenue and spending.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，裁定六曹、寺監百司吏額。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: clerical quotas for the Six Ministries, directorates, and hundred offices were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, clerk quotas were set for the Six Ministries, directorates, and agencies.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，命三省錄台諫所言事報樞密院。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: the Three Departments were ordered to record remonstrators' and censors' reports and forward them to the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinchou: the Three Departments were to log remonstrators' and censors' reports for the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，万俟禼上《重修貢舉敕令格式》。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Moqi Xi submitted the Revised Examination Edicts and Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Moqi Xi submitted the Revised Examination Edicts and Regulations.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷諸路鑄錢司。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: circuit coin-casting offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, circuit mint offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賞應詔論事切當者。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: those who answered edicts with pointed, fitting counsel were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, men whose edict responses were sharp and apt were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，三佛齊國入貢。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Srivijaya sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Srivijaya sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金遣梁𥆿等來加明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Jin sent Liang Song and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Jin sent Liang Song and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月乙酉，幸延祥觀。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, day yiyou: the Emperor visited Extended Felicity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 27, first month, yiyou: Gaozong visited Extended Felicity Abbey.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命侍從各薦宗室京朝官才識、治行者二人。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: attendant officials were each to recommend two imperial clansmen or capital officials of talent and good governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, each attendant was to name two talented, well-governed clansmen or capital officials.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，復兼習經義、詩賦法。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou new moon: the combined study of classical meaning and regulated verse was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingyou new moon: candidates again studied both classical meaning and regulated verse.

sentences.zh: 庚子，楊政卒。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Zheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Zheng died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太廟仁宗、英宗兩室柱芝草生。

translations.literal: Day renyin: lingzhi fungus grew on the pillars of the Renzong and Yingzong chambers in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, lingzhi grew on pillars in the Renzong and Yingzong temple chambers.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以御史中丞湯鵬舉參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Investigating Censor Tang Pengju was made Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Investigating Censor Tang Pengju became Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，更定福建路鹽法。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Fujian salt law was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Fujian salt law was revised.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加劉錡太尉。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Liu Qi was advanced to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Liu Qi was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，命京局改官人先除知縣。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: men promoted from capital posts were first to be appointed county prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jisi: men raised from capital posts had to serve first as county prefect.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，赤氣出紫微垣。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: red vapor issued from the Purple Forbidden enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, red vapor rose from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜禮部進士王十朋以下四百二十六人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: four hundred twenty-six men including Ministry of Rites Presented Scholar Wang Shipeng were granted jinshi degrees and passes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Shipeng and 425 others received jinshi degrees and passes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔焚交阯所貢翠羽於通衢，仍禁宮人服用銷金翠羽。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict ordered the kingfisher feathers Jiaozhi had presented burned in the public thoroughfare and forbade palace women to wear gilt kingfisher ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Jiaozhi's tribute kingfisher feathers were burned in the street and palace women were barred from gilt kingfisher dress.

sentences.zh: 己丑，減三川對糴米歲十六萬九千石，夔路激賞絹五萬匹，兩川絹估錢二十八萬緡及茶司引息虛額錢歲九十五萬緡。

translations.literal: Day jichou: paired-purchase grain in the three Sichuan circuits was cut by one hundred sixty-nine thousand shi yearly; Kuizhou route incentive silk by fifty thousand bolts; silk valuation money in both Sichuan circuits by two hundred eighty thousand strings; and the tea office's fictitious interest by nine hundred fifty thousand strings yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Sichuan paired-purchase grain fell 169,000 shi a year; Kuizhou incentive silk 50,000 bolts; both circuits' silk valuation 280,000 strings; and tea-office phantom interest 950,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，万俟禼卒。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Moqi Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Moqi Xi died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以符行中前在蜀恣橫，南雄州安置。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Fu Xingzhong, for earlier tyranny in Shu, was ordered to reside at Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Fu Xingzhong—once brutal in Shu—was banished to Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，除耕牛稅。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the plow-ox tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the plow-ox tax was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，金遣耶律守素等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei: the Jin sent Yelü Shousu and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiwei: the Jin sent Yelü Shousu and others for the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復以五帝、神州地祇等十三祭為大祀。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the thirteen sacrifices to the Five Thearchs and the Spirit Lord of the Land within the Realm were again made great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, thirteen rites to the Five Thearchs and the Spirit Lord of the Land were restored as great sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，命臣僚轉對，盡忠開陳，毋摭細微以應故事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: officials were ordered to rotate memorializing, opening their hearts loyally and not picking trifles to meet routine.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: officials were told to speak frankly in rotation, not nitpick to satisfy form.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以湯思退為尚書右僕射、同中中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Tang Situi was made Minister of the Right and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Tang Situi became Right Minister and Associate Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復余深、黃潛善並觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Yu Shen and Huang Qianshan were both restored as Duanwen Hall academicians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yu Shen and Huang Qianshan were both restored as Duanwen Hall academicians.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，裁定離軍將士諸州添差數。

translations.literal: Day yimao: added-assignment quotas for discharged soldiers in the prefectures were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, prefectural quotas for discharged soldiers on added assignment were set.

sentences.zh: 戊午，初命太廟冬饗祭功臣，臘饗祭七祀，祫饗兼之。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: it was first ordered that at the winter offering in the Imperial Ancestral Temple meritorious ministers be sacrificed, at the wax offering the seven sacrifices, and at the triennial collective offering both together.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, winter temple offerings first honored merit ministers, wax offerings the seven sacrifices, and triennial collective rites combined both.

sentences.zh: 己未，進錢忱少傅。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Qian Chen was advanced to Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Qian Chen became Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 增命官捕獲私茶鹽賞典。

translations.literal: Reward standards for ranked officials who captured smuggled tea and salt were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards rose for ranked officials who seized smuggled tea and salt.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，復饒、贛、韶三州鑄錢監。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: coin mints in Rao, Gan, and Shao prefectures were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jisi: mints in Rao, Gan, and Shao were restored.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，戒監司、郡守舉劾守令觀望徇私。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: circuit supervisors and prefects were warned to impeach magistrates who looked on indulgently or showed favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, circuit chiefs and prefects were warned to impeach lenient or partial magistrates.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以龍圖閣學士李文會為四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Dragon Diagram academician Li Wen was made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Wen of Dragon Diagram Hall became Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔凡出命，令先經兩省書讀，如舊制。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict ordered that hereafter every issued command first pass through the two departments for written review, as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, every command had again to pass both departments for written review, as before.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，以湯鵬舉知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: Tang Pengju was made Privy Council Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiwei: Tang Pengju became Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復置提領諸路鑄錢司於行在，以戶部侍郎榮薿領之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the office directing circuit coin casting was restored at the mobile court; Vice Minister of Revenue Rong Nai was placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the circuit coin office was restored at court; Revenue Vice Minister Rong Nai headed it.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，張綱罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Zhang Gang left office.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiyou: Zhang Gang left office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吏部尚書陳康伯參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Minister of Personnel Chen Kangbo was made Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Chen Kangbo of Personnel became Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 蠲淮南、京西、湖北積欠內藏錢帛。

translations.literal: Accumulated arrears owed the inner treasury in Huainan, Jingxi, and Hubei were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Piled-up inner-treasury debt in Huainan, Jingxi, and Hubei was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，校書郎葉謙亨言：「祀典散逸，隆殺不當，名稱或舛，請敕禮官、秘書酌景德故事，取祭祀之式，定為一書，名曰《紹興正祠錄》，以為恒制。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Proofreader Ye Qianheng said: "Sacrificial canons are scattered and lost; gradation of honor is wrong; some names are mistaken. I ask that ritual officers and the Imperial Library, following Jingde precedents, take existing sacrifice forms and fix one book called Records of Correct Sacrifices under Shaoxing as the permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, proofreader Ye Qianheng said, "Sacrificial codes are scattered, ranks wrong, and names mistaken. Let ritual officers and the Imperial Library, using Jingde precedents, compile one book, Records of Correct Sacrifices under Shaoxing, as the standing rule.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: " The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，有赤氣隨日入。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: red vapor followed the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renyin: red vapor trailed the setting sun.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，築通、泰、楚三州捍海堰。

translations.literal: Day guimao: sea dikes were built at Tong, Tai, and Chu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, sea dikes rose at Tong, Tai, and Chu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉、詔四川諸司察旱傷州縣，捐其稅，振其饑民。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: an edict ordered all Sichuan offices to inspect drought- and disaster-struck counties, cut their taxes, and relieve the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Sichuan offices were to find drought- and disaster-hit counties, cut tax, and feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥朔，減福建鹽鈔錢歲八萬緡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai new moon: Fujian salt-certificate money was cut by eighty thousand strings yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai new moon: Fujian salt certificates cost eighty thousand fewer strings a year.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣孫道夫使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Sun Daofu was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Sun Daofu went to the Jin for New Year's.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣劉章賀金主生辰，丁亥，湯鵬舉罷。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Liu Zhang was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday. Day dinghai: Tang Pengju left office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Liu Zhang went for the Jin ruler's birthday. On dinghai, Tang Pengju left office.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蠲廬州二稅及上供錢米一年。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Lu prefecture's two taxes and tribute grain and money for one year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Lu's two taxes and one year of tribute grain and money were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，詔廣南經略、市舶司察蕃商假託入貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: an edict ordered the Guangnan pacification and maritime trade offices to investigate foreign merchants falsely posing as tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiawu: Guangnan pacification and trade offices were to catch foreign merchants posing as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，初命州縣置禁曆。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: prefectures and counties were first ordered to keep forbidden calendars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, prefectures and counties were first told to keep forbidden calendars.

sentences.zh: 戊午，金遣高思廉等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Jin sent Gao Silian and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Jin sent Gao Silian and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月己巳，申禁三衙強刺平民為兵。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, day jisi: forced conscription of civilians by the Three Yamaz was again forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 28, first month, jisi: the Three Yamaz were again barred from forcibly drafting civilians.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸延祥觀，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Emperor visited Extended Felicity Abbey, then Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Gaozong visited Extended Felicity Abbey, then Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禁諸路二稅折納增價。

translations.literal: Day renwu: circuits were forbidden to raise prices when collecting the two taxes in kind.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, circuits could not mark up in-kind two-tax collection.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣戶部郎中莫濛等檢視淮南、浙西、江東沙田蘆場。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Revenue Bureau Director Mo Meng and others were sent to inspect sand fields and reed marshes in Huainan, western Zhe, and eastern Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Mo Meng of Revenue and others were sent to inspect sand fields and reed marshes in Huainan, western Zhe, and eastern Jiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命台諫、侍從三人以上公薦監司治狀。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: remonstrators, censors, and three or more attendants were ordered jointly to recommend supervisors' records of governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, remonstrators, censors, and three or more attendants were to recommend supervisors' performance jointly.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，命史館重修徽宗大觀以前實錄。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi: the History Office was ordered to revise the veritable records before Huizong's Daguan reign.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guisi: the History Office was told to revise records before Huizong's Daguan era.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以陳誠之知樞密院。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Chen Chengzhi was made Privy Council Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Chen Chengzhi became Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禁沿海州軍博買。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: coastal prefectures and armies were forbidden to force purchases.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, coastal prefectures and garrisons were barred from forced buying.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以工部侍郎王綸同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Vice Minister of Works Wang Lun was made Associate Privy Council Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Wang Lun of Works became Associate Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命六曹長貳詳定差役舊法。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: heads and deputies of the Six Ministries were ordered to review the old corvée-exemption law in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Six Ministry chiefs and deputies were told to review the old corvée-exemption law.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，加楊存中少師，諡張俊曰忠烈。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Yang Cunzhong was advanced to Junior Mentor; Zhang Jun was given the posthumous title Loyal and Ardent.
