translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yang Cunzhong became Junior Mentor; Zhang Jun was posthumously titled Loyal and Ardent.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou new moon: eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinyou new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，雪。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: snow.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, it snowed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，加田師中開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Tian Shizhong was advanced to Grand Guardian with ceremonial trappings equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Tian Shizhong received Grand Guardian rank with Three Excellency honors.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔：「自今用人，選帥臣、監司曾任郎官已上者為侍從，監司、郡守有政績者為卿監、郎官，朝官二年乃遷，卿監、郎官未曆監司者更迭補外。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict said: "From now on in appointments: choose commanders and supervisors who have served as court gentlemen or higher for attendant posts; choose supervisors and prefects with achievements for ministry and court-gentleman posts; court gentlemen advance only after two years; ministry and court gentlemen who have not served as supervisors rotate in turn to outer posts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict said, "Henceforth: pick commanders and supervisors who reached court gentleman or above for attendant posts; pick supervisors and prefects with records for ministry and court-gentleman posts; court gentlemen wait two years to advance; ministry and court gentlemen without supervisory service rotate to outer posts.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，責秦檜党宋樸徽州居住，沈虛中筠州居住。

translations.literal: " Day wuzi: Song Pu of the Qin faction was ordered to reside at Huizhou; Shen Xuzhong at Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi, Qin partisan Song Pu was sent to Huizhou and Shen Xuzhong to Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，復詔文武官非犯贓罪，並許以致仕恩任子。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingshen: an edict again allowed civil and military officials not guilty of graft to use retirement privilege to appoint a son.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingshen: civil and military officials not guilty of graft could again use retirement privilege to appoint a son.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: hail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 嚴州遂安賊江大明寇衢州，官軍捕斬之。

translations.literal: Yan prefecture's Suian bandit Jiang Daming raided Quzhou; government troops hunted and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Daming, a Suian bandit in Yan, raided Quzhou; troops hunted him down and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 五月，金遣蕭恭等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Jin sent Xiao Gong and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the Jin sent Xiao Gong and others for the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: Taibai was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day guisi: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，增浙西、江東、淮東沙田蘆場租課，置提領官田所掌之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: rent on sand fields and reed marshes in western Zhe, eastern Jiang, and eastern Huai was increased, and an office to oversee official fields was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, rent rose on sand fields and reed marshes in western Zhe, eastern Jiang, and eastern Huai, and a chief official-field office was created.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，立江西上供米綱賞格。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: reward standards for Jiangxi tribute-grain convoys were established.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengshen: Jiangxi tribute-grain convoy rewards were fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔：「監司按發官吏，不得送置司州軍推鞫。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict said: "When supervisors impeach officials, they may not send them to the supervisor's own prefecture for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, an edict said, "Supervisors impeaching officials may not send cases to their own prefecture for trial.

sentences.zh: 所犯涉重，即以奏聞，命鄰路監司選官就鞫。

translations.literal: If the offense is grave, report at once; a neighboring circuit supervisor is to choose an official to try the case on site.
translations.idiomatic: Grave cases go straight to court; a neighboring supervisor picks an officer to try on the spot.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，命取公私銅器悉付鑄錢司，民間不輸者罪之。

translations.literal: " Day jimao: all public and private bronze vessels were ordered delivered to the coin office; civilians who failed to turn them in were punished.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao, public and private bronze went to the mint; civilians who withheld it were punished.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，親制郊廟樂章。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Emperor personally composed suburban and temple hymn texts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Gaozong wrote suburban and temple hymns himself.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，復鬻沒官田。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: sale of confiscated official fields was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, sale of confiscated official fields was restored.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，置國史院，修神、哲、徽三朝正史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi new moon: the National History Office was established to compile the correct histories of Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuzi new moon: the National History Office was set up to compile Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong's official histories.

sentences.zh: 己丑，檢放風水災傷州縣苗稅，仍振貸饑民。

translations.literal: Day jichou: seedling tax in wind- and flood-struck counties was checked and remitted, and the hungry were lent relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, storm- and flood-hit counties had seedling tax cut and the hungry received relief loans.

sentences.zh: 乙未，增四川十七州舉人解額。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: examination quotas in seventeen Sichuan prefectures were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, examination quotas rose in seventeen Sichuan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，湯思退等上《徽宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Tang Situi and others presented the Veritable Record of Huizong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Tang Situi and others submitted Huizong's Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命戶部侍郎令詪提領諸路鑄錢。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Vice Minister of Revenue Ling He was placed in charge of circuit coin casting.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Revenue Vice Minister Ling He headed circuit coin casting.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，地震。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，定銅錢出界罪賞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: penalties and rewards for exporting copper cash beyond the border were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinwei: penalties and rewards for smuggling copper cash abroad were set.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔以吏部七司舊制與續降參訂異同，立為定法。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: an edict ordered the Personnel Ministry's seven bureaus to collate old regulations with later additions, reconcile differences, and establish permanent law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Personnel's seven bureaus were to merge old rules with later orders, reconcile gaps, and fix permanent law.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置殿前司虎翼水軍千人。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: a thousand Tiger-Wing River sailors were established in the Palace Front Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Palace Front Army gained a thousand Tiger-Wing river sailors.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以中書舍人王剛中為四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Secretariat drafter Wang Gangzhong was made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Gangzhong of the Secretariat became Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，封叔建州觀察使士輵為昭化軍節度使、嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Imperial clansman and Jiankang observer Shi Yi was enfeoffed military commissioner of Zhaohua and heir to the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, clansman and Jiankang observer Shi Yi was made Zhaohua military commissioner and heir to the Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蠲平江、紹興、湖州被水民逋賦。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: arrears of flood victims in Pingjiang, Shaoxing, and Huzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, flood victims' arrears in Pingjiang, Shaoxing, and Huzhou were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，遣沈介使金賀正旦，黃中賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dinghai new moon: Shen Jie was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's; Huang Zhong to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dinghai new moon: Shen Jie went to the Jin for New Year's; Huang Zhong for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，禁監司、帥、守私役軍匠。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: supervisors, commanders, and prefects were forbidden to use army artisans for private service.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, supervisors, commanders, and prefects could not privately employ army artisans.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月丙辰朔，以皇太后年八十，詣慈甯殿行慶壽禮。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, day bingchen new moon: because the Empress Dowager was eighty, celebratory rites for long life were performed at Cining Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 29, first month, bingchen new moon: with the Empress Dowager eighty, long-life rites were held at Cining Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，浚平江三十六浦以泄水。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: thirty-six creeks in Pingjiang were dredged to drain water.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, thirty-six Pingjiang creeks were dredged for drainage.

sentences.zh: 庚午，振湖、秀諸州饑民。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: hungry people in Hu and Xiu prefectures were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the hungry in Hu and Xiu were fed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸延祥觀，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Emperor visited Extended Felicity Abbey, then Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Gaozong visited Extended Felicity Abbey, then Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禁諸州科賣倉鹽。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: prefectures were forbidden to levy forced sales of granary salt.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, prefectures could not force-sale granary salt.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蠲沙田蘆場為風水所侵者租之半。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: rent on sand fields and reed marshes damaged by wind and water was halved.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, rent was halved on storm-damaged sand fields and reed marshes.

sentences.zh: 是月，金國罷沿邊榷場，惟泗州如舊。

translations.literal: That month: the Jin abolished frontier trade stations; only Sizhou remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin shut frontier markets; only Sizhou stayed open.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌朔，亦罷沿邊榷場，存其在盱眙者。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu new moon: frontier trade stations were also abolished on the Song side; only the one at Xuyi was kept.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu new moon: Song frontier markets closed too; only Xuyi's remained.

sentences.zh: 加吳璘少保。

translations.literal: Wu Lin was advanced to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁海商假託風潮私往北界。

translations.literal: Day jichou: seagoing merchants were forbidden to use storms as a pretext to sail privately to the northern realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, seagoing merchants could not cite storms to sail privately north.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，除臨安府歲供修內司錢三萬六千緡。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Lin'an's yearly payment to the Palace Construction Office was cut by thirty-six thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Lin'an's yearly Palace Construction payment fell thirty-six thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，蠲四川折估糴本積欠錢三百四十萬緡。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: three million four hundred thousand strings of Sichuan's piled-up discounted-purchase principal were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, 3.4 million strings of Sichuan's piled-up discounted-purchase debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大雪，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: heavy snow; hail.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, heavy snow and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁貿易廣南羈縻州物貨。

translations.literal: Day jihai: trade in goods from Guangnan's dependent prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, trade in goods from Guangnan dependent prefectures was banned.

sentences.zh: 命廣西教閱峒丁。

translations.literal: Guangxi was ordered to drill cave militia.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi was told to drill cave militia.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷諸路斥侯遞卒。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: courier relay scouts on all circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, circuit courier scouts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，取具貶死臣僚姓名，議加恩典。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a list was drawn up of demoted and executed officials to consider restoring favors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, demoted and executed officials were listed for possible restoration of honors.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，除州縣積欠錢三百九十七萬緡有奇，及中下戶所欠入宮錢物。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: accumulated prefectural and county debts of three million ninety-seven thousand odd strings were remitted, and debts owed the palace by lower-middle households.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingzi: 3.97 million strings of piled-up prefectural debt and lower-middle households' palace debts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔侍從、台諫、帥臣、監司歲舉可任將帥者二人。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered attendants, remonstrators, censors, commanders, and supervisors each year to recommend two men fit for generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, attendants, remonstrators, censors, commanders, and supervisors were yearly to name two men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 限命官子孫制田減父祖之半，並其詭名寄產者，格外田畝同編戶科役。

translations.literal: Sons of ranked officials were limited to half their fathers' and grandfathers' fields; those with hidden names and entrusted holdings had extra acreage taxed like registered households.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked officials' sons could hold only half their fathers' and grandfathers' land; hidden and entrusted plots beyond that were taxed like ordinary households.

sentences.zh: 己卯，除湖州、平江、紹興流民公私逋負。

translations.literal: Day jimao: public and private arrears of refugees in Huzhou, Pingjiang, and Shaoxing were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, public and private debts of refugees in Huzhou, Pingjiang, and Shaoxing were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，國子司業黃中自金國使還，言金人將徙居汴京以見逼，望早飭邊備。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renchen: National University Vice Director Huang Zhong returned from his Jin mission and said the Jin would move to Bianjing and felt pressed; he asked that frontier defenses be readied early.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renchen: Huang Zhong of the National University, back from the Jin, said they would move to Bianjing under pressure and urged early frontier readiness.

sentences.zh: 宰相怒，不聽。

translations.literal: The chief ministers were angry and would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were angry and ignored him.

sentences.zh: 己亥，修三省法。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the regulations of the Three Departments were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Three Departments regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 庚子，增置帶禦器械四員。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: four additional posts of Bearer of the Imperial Arms were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, four more Bearer of the Imperial Arms posts were added.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁內外將佐營造、回易，掊斂軍士。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: inner and outer commanders were forbidden to build projects and trade for profit, or squeeze the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, inner and outer commanders could not run building projects or trade for profit or squeeze troops.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命縣令有政績者諸司同薦，不次升擢，以風厲之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: magistrates with achievements were to be jointly recommended by all offices and promoted out of turn to encourage others.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, achieving magistrates were to be jointly recommended by all offices and promoted out of turn as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅朔，罷鬻福建閃生沙田。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin new moon: sale of Fujian's tidal sand fields was ended.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiayin new moon: sale of Fujian tidal sand fields ended.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔殿前司選統制官部兵千人戍江州，彈壓盜賊，每歲一易。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict ordered the Palace Front Army to choose a commander to garrison Jiangzhou with a thousand troops to suppress bandits, rotated yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Palace Front Army was to pick a commander yearly for a thousand men at Jiangzhou against bandits.

sentences.zh: 己未，樁頓江、浙四路折帛錢於三總領所及浙西提刑司，以備軍用。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: silk-cash reserves of the four Jiang and Zhe circuits were stockpiled at the three overall finance offices and the western Zhe judicial commission for military use.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Jiang-Zhe silk-cash reserves were piled at the three overall finance offices and western Zhe judicial commission for war.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁權要、豪民舉錢軍中取息。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: powerful men and great families were forbidden to lend at interest inside the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, magnates and great clans could not lend at interest inside the armies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命印給三總領所見錢公據、關子，許商人入納。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the three overall finance offices were ordered to print cash receipts and exchange notes, allowing merchants to pay in.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the three overall finance offices were to print cash receipts and exchange notes merchants could redeem.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立監司、守臣舉劾八條。

translations.literal: Day jisi: eight articles for supervisors and prefects to impeach by were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, eight impeachment articles were set for supervisors and prefects.

sentences.zh: 金遣王可道等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Wang Kedao and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Wang Kedao and others for the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，遣王綸等為金國奉表稱謝使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen new moon: Wang Lun and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to present a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen new moon: Wang Lun and others went to the Jin with a thanksgiving memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁江、淮私渡北人。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: private crossings on the Yangzi and Huai for northerners were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, private Yangzi and Huai crossings for northerners were banned.

sentences.zh: 丙申，陳誠之罷。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Chen Chengzhi left office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Chen Chengzhi left office.

sentences.zh: 禁積錢民戶過萬緡，官戶過二萬緡，滿二年不易他物者沒入之。

translations.literal: Hoarding cash beyond ten thousand strings by civilians and twenty thousand by officials, not converted to other goods within two years, was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Civilians hoarding over ten thousand strings of cash—or officials twenty thousand—without spending it within two years had it confiscated.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，申禁包苴請托。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: gift bribery and pull requests were again forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, gift bribery and pull requests were again banned.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以陳康伯兼權樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Chen Kangbo was additionally made Acting Privy Council Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Chen Kangbo also became Acting Privy Council Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李光卒。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Li Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Guang died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以主管步軍司趙密為太尉。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zhao Mi, chief of the Infantry Command, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhao Mi, chief of the Infantry Command, was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 己酉，沈該以貪冒罷。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Shen Gai was dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Shen Gai was dismissed for graft.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，益荊南戍卒千人，守臣劉錡亦募效用三千人。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiayin: Jingnan garrison was increased by a thousand men; defender Liu Qi also recruited three thousand volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jiayin: Jingnan gained a thousand garrison troops; defender Liu Qi also raised three thousand volunteers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命江、湖、浙西五漕司增價糴米二百二十萬石赴沿江十郡，自荊至常州，以備振貸。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the five transport commissioners of Jiang, lakes, and western Zhe were ordered to buy grain at higher prices—two million two hundred thousand shi—and send it to ten coastal prefectures from Jing to Changzhou for relief stores.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, five transport commissioners on Jiang, lake, and western Zhe routes were to buy 2.2 million shi of grain at premium prices for ten coastal prefectures from Jing to Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷成都府路隔槽酒務監官七十一員，令民承買。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: seventy-one supervisory posts for partitioned wine monopolies on the Chengdu route were abolished and the people were allowed to bid for them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, seventy-one Chengdu-route wine-monopoly supervisors were cut and the public could bid for the franchises.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷江、浙、淮東沙田蘆場所增租課。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: added rent on sand fields and reed marshes in Jiang, Zhe, and eastern Huai was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, added rent on Jiang, Zhe, and eastern Huai sand fields and reed marshes was dropped.

sentences.zh: 甲子，落沈該觀文殿大學士，致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Shen Gai was stripped of Duanwen Hall academician and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Shen Gai lost Duanwen Hall rank and retired.

sentences.zh: 罷福建安撫司官賣鹽。

translations.literal: Fujian pacification office sale of official salt was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian pacification office salt sales ended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大省淮西冗官。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: redundant officials in western Huai were sharply cut.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, western Huai redundant posts were sharply cut.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復置江、淮、荊、浙、福建、廣南路提點坑冶鑄錢官。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the posts supervising mining and coin casting on the Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, Fujian, and Guangnan routes were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, mining-and-mint supervisors on Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, Fujian, and Guangnan routes were restored.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，以權吏部尚書賀允中參知政事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: Acting Minister of Personnel He Yunzhong was made Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dinghai: Acting Personnel Minister He Yunzhong became Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，封權戶部侍郎令詪為安定郡王。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Acting Vice Minister of Revenue Ling He was enfeoffed Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Acting Revenue Vice Minister Ling He was created Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，福州大水。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Fuzhou suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Fuzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁諸路抑買官田。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: all circuits were forbidden to force-buy official fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, circuits could not force-buy official fields.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以四川經、總制及田晟錢糧錢共百三十四萬緡充增招軍校費。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: one million three hundred forty thousand strings from Sichuan's overall finance, overall control, and Tian Sheng grain-money funds were allotted to pay for added recruitment of army officers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, 1.34 million strings from Sichuan overall finance, overall control, and Tian Sheng grain funds went to recruit more army officers.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，募商人輸米行在諸倉，願以茶、鹽、礬鈔等償直者聽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: merchants were recruited to deliver grain to capital granaries, allowed to be repaid in tea, salt, alum certificates, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiazi: merchants were recruited to ship grain to capital granaries, repayable in tea, salt, alum certificates, and the like.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，除南雄、英、連三州經界，復丁米舊額。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: land boundaries in Nanxiong, Ying, and Lian prefectures were ended; old head-rice quotas were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, land boundaries ended in Nanxiong, Ying, and Lian; old head-rice quotas returned.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，並史館歸秘書省，玉牒所歸宗正寺。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the History Office was merged into the Imperial Library; the Jade Register Office into the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the History Office joined the Imperial Library and the Jade Register Office the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，詔建炎以來使未還而後嗣無祿者，與一子官。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: an edict granted one son an office to envoys who since Jianyan had not returned and whose heirs had no stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiashen: envoys missing since Jianyan whose heirs lacked stipends received one son with office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，王綸使還入見，言金國和好無他。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wang Lun returned from his mission and reported that Jin relations were sound and unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wang Lun, back from the Jin, said relations were sound and unchanged.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，湯思退等稱賀。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Tang Situi and others offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Tang Situi and others offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以湯思退為尚書左僕射，陳康伯為右僕射，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Tang Situi was made Minister of the Left; Chen Kangbo Minister of the Right; both Associate Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Tang Situi became Left Minister and Chen Kangbo Right Minister, both Associate Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以皇太后不豫，大赦，不視朝。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: because the Empress Dowager was ill, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the court did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, with the Empress Dowager ill, there was a great amnesty and no court audience.

sentences.zh: 丙申，為太后祈福。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: prayers were offered for the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, prayers were offered for the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 蠲中下戶所欠稅賦及江、浙蝗潦州縣租。

translations.literal: Taxes owed by lower-middle households and rents in locust- and flood-struck Jiang and Zhe counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Lower-middle households' tax arrears and rents in Jiang-Zhe locust- and flood-hit counties were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，減僧道免丁錢。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: monks' and Daoists' corvée-exemption fees were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, monks' and Daoists' corvée-exemption fees were cut.

sentences.zh: 己亥，蠲見監贓罰賞錢。

translations.literal: Day jihai: fines and reward money from current prison cases were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, fines and reward money from open prison cases were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇太后韋氏崩。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Empress Dowager Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Empress Dowager Wei died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣周麟之等為金國奉表哀謝使。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhou Linzhi and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to present a memorial of mourning and thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhou Linzhi and others went to the Jin with a mourning and thanksgiving memorial.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，以群臣五上表，始聽政。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: because the hundred officials had submitted five memorials, the Emperor at last resumed audience.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiayin: after five ministerial pleas, Gaozong at last held court again.

sentences.zh: 命保康軍節度使吳益為欑宮總護使。

translations.literal: Bao Kang army military commissioner Wu Yi was made overall director of the temporary burial palace.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yi, Bao Kang military commissioner, became overall director of the temporary burial palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，立諸路和糴募民妄運米賞格。

translations.literal: Day yihai: reward standards were set for civilians who rashly transported grain under the circuit harmonized-purchase system.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, reward rules were set for rash grain hauling under circuit harmonized purchase.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，冊諡皇太后曰顯仁。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Empress Dowager was given the temple name Xianren.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Empress Dowager received the temple name Xianren.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，遣賀允中等為金國遺留國信使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: He Yunzhong and others were sent as envoys bearing remaining credentials to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dinghai: He Yunzhong and others went to the Jin with remaining state letters.

sentences.zh: 丙午，權欑顯仁皇后于永祐陵。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Empress Xianren was temporarily enshrined at Yongyou Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Empress Xianren was temporarily placed at Yongyou Tomb.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，諜言北界禁民傳起兵，帝諭大臣常自治，為安邊息民之計。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin: intelligence said the northern realm had forbidden the people to spread talk of raising troops. The Emperor told his ministers to govern themselves constantly as a plan to secure the border and give the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: reports said the north had banned talk of mobilizing troops. Gaozong told his ministers to keep order at home to secure the border and let the people rest.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祔顯仁皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Empress Dowager Xianren's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Empress Dowager Xianren's tablet was placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以王綸知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wang Lun was made Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wang Lun became Privy Council commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，減三省、樞密院激賞庫及諸書局歲用錢二十萬緡，鼎州程昌寓所增蔡州官兵衣糧錢四之一，西和州官賣鹽直之半，蔣州上供經、總制司無額錢如之。

translations.literal: Day renshen: annual spending of the Three Departments, the Privy Council reward treasury, and the various book offices was cut by 200,000 strings; one quarter of the clothing and grain money Cheng Changyu had added for Cai prefecture troops at Ding prefecture; half the proceeds of official salt sales at Xihe prefecture; and Jiang prefecture's quota-less remittance of general and circuit treasury funds likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, yearly outlays of the Three Departments, the Privy Council reward treasury, and book offices were cut 200,000 strings; Ding's Cheng Changyu lost a quarter of added Cai troop pay; Xihe official salt sales were halved; Jiang's quota-less general and circuit treasury remittance matched those cuts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣施宜生等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Jin sent Shi Yisheng and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Jin sent Shi Yisheng and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊子，給劉錡軍費錢六十萬緡。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, spring, first month, day wuzi: 600,000 strings were granted for Liu Qi's army expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Thirtieth year, spring, wuzi: 600,000 strings were allotted for Liu Qi's armies.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以吏部侍郎葉義問同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Secretariat Vice Director Ye Yiwen was made co-equal Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Secretariat Vice Director Ye Yiwen became co-equal Privy Council commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廢禦書院。

translations.literal: The Imperial Calligraphy Academy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Calligraphy Academy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷鈞容班樂工及甲庫酒局。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Junrong entertainment troupe musicians and the Jia Depot wine bureau were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Junrong troupe musicians and the Jia Depot wine bureau were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，募人墾淮南荒田。

translations.literal: Day renyin: men were recruited to reclaim wasteland in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, recruits were enlisted to open wasteland in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，定禦輦院三營兵額為九百人。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Imperial Escort Directorate's three-camp troop quota was set at nine hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Imperial Escort Directorate fixed three camps at nine hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，罷夔州路榷茶。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin: the Kui prefecture circuit tea monopoly was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiayin: the Kui circuit tea monopoly ended.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，金遣大懷忠等來弔祭。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Jin sent Da Huaizhong and others to perform mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Jin sent Da Huaizhong and others for mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣葉義問為金國報謝使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Ye Yiwen was sent as Jin return-thanks envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Ye Yiwen was sent to the Jin to return thanks.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔立普安郡王瑗為皇子，更名瑋。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict made Prince of Pu'an Jun heir prince, renaming him Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Prince of Pu'an was made heir prince and renamed Wei.

sentences.zh: 丙子，進封建王。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: he was advanced to Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he was raised to Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，復館職召試，然後除擢。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: museum posts were again filled by call-for-examination, then appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinsi: museum posts again required examination before appointment.

sentences.zh: 免湖北、京西宣撫司諸庫未輸錢八十九萬緡。

translations.literal: Eight hundred and ninety thousand strings still unpaid from the Hubei and Jingxi Pacification commissariat vaults were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: 890,000 strings owed from Hubei and Jingxi pacification vaults were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以淮東茶鹽司錢十萬緡充募民墾田費。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: 100,000 strings from the Huaidong tea and salt office were allotted for reclaiming wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, 100,000 strings from Huaidong tea and salt were set aside to open wasteland.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加吳益少保，趙密開府儀同三司，以賞欑宮之勞。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wu Yi was made Junior Guardian and Zhao Mi Pillar of State, rewarding service at the coffining palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wu Yi became Junior Guardian and Zhao Mi Pillar of State for coffining-palace service.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，初置金州御前諸軍都統制，以知金州王彥為之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Jinzhou Mobile Court Army Commander-in-Chief was first established, with Jin prefecture administrator Wang Yan appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Jinzhou Mobile Court Army command was created and Wang Yan, Jin prefect, was made commander.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜禮部進士梁克家以下四百一十二人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Metropolitan Examination graduates Liang Kejia and four hundred twelve others were granted jinshi degrees and court entry.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liang Kejia and 412 Metropolitan graduates received jinshi and court entry.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置牧馬監于潮、惠二州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: a Horse Pasturage Bureau was set up in Chao and Hui prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, a Horse Pasturage Bureau was placed in Chao and Hui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加恩平郡王璩開府儀同三司、判大宗正事，始稱皇侄。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Prince of Enping Jun Xi was made Pillar of State and Grand Imperial Clan Director and was first styled imperial nephew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Prince of Enping Xi became Pillar of State and Grand Imperial Clan Director and was first called imperial nephew.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，以孫愭為蘄州防禦使，愷貴州團練使，惇榮州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou new moon: grandson Qi was made Su prefecture defense commissioner; Kai, Guizhou regimentation trainer; Dun, Rong prefectural administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiyou new moon: grandson Qi became Su defense commissioner, Kai Guizhou trainer, and Dun Rong administrator.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以賀允中兼權同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: He Yunzhong was made acting co-equal Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, He Yunzhong became acting co-equal Privy Council commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，刺海賊罪不至死者為龍猛、龍騎軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: pirates whose crimes did not merit death were tattooed into the Dragon Fierce and Dragon Rider armies.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinsi: pirates spared death were tattooed into Dragon Fierce and Dragon Rider.

sentences.zh: 初置荊南府御前諸軍都統制，以劉錡兼領之。

translations.literal: The Jingnanfu Mobile Court Army Commander-in-Chief was first established, with Liu Qi concurrently holding the post.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnanfu Mobile Court Army command was created with Liu Qi as concurrent commander.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，初置江州御前諸軍都統制，以步軍司前軍都統制戚方為之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Jiangzhou Mobile Court Army Commander-in-Chief was first established, with former Infantry Command vanguard army controller Qi Fang appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Jiangzhou Mobile Court Army command was created and Qi Fang, former vanguard controller, was appointed.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路刺強盜貸死少壯者為兵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered every circuit to tattoo severe bandits whose death sentences were commuted and enroll able-bodied young men as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Circuits were told to tattoo commuted bandits and enroll young able-bodied men as troops.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定鑄錢司歲鑄五十萬緡。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Coinage Bureau's yearly casting was fixed at five hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Coinage Bureau's annual cast was fixed at 500,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，臨安、于潛、安吉三縣大水。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Lin'an, Yuqian, and Anji three counties suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Lin'an, Yuqian, and Anji were heavily flooded.

sentences.zh: 海賊陳演添作亂，掠高、雷二州境上，南恩州民林觀禽殺之，命觀以官。

translations.literal: The pirate Chen Yantian rebelled and raided the borders of Gao and Lei prefectures; Lin Guan of Nan'en prefecture killed him and was given office.
translations.idiomatic: Pirate Chen Yantian rebelled on the Gao-Lei border; Nan'en's Lin Guan killed him and received an appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金遣蕭榮等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Jin sent Xiao Rong and others to congratulate the Tianshen Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Jin sent Xiao Rong and others for the Tianshen Festival.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，落沈該致仕，復觀文殿大學士、知明州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Shen Gai's retirement ended; he was restored to Grand Mentor and made administrator of Ming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Shen Gai left retirement, regained Grand Mentor, and governed Ming.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加吳益太尉。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wu Yi was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wu Yi became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，復出諸軍見錢關子三百萬緡，聽商賈以錢銀請買。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: three million strings in cash exchange notes for the armies were again issued, merchants being allowed to buy them with cash and silver.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengxu: three million strings in army exchange notes were reissued, merchants permitted to buy them for cash or silver.

sentences.zh: 庚午，王倫罷。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Wang Lun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Lun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以江西廣東湖南折帛、經總製錢合六十萬緡，江西米六萬石充江州軍費。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Jiangxi, Guangdong, and Hunan silk-commutation and general and circuit treasury funds totaling six hundred thousand strings, and Jiangxi rice sixty thousand shi, were allotted for Jiangzhou army expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, 600,000 strings from Jiangxi, Guangdong, and Hunan silk-commutation and general treasuries plus 60,000 shi of Jiangxi rice were allotted to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 後益以四川利路經總制、江西茶引合二十萬緡。

translations.literal: Later another two hundred thousand strings from Sichuan's profit-route general and circuit treasury and Jiangxi tea certificates were added.
translations.idiomatic: Later 200,000 more strings from Sichuan profit-route treasuries and Jiangxi tea certificates were added.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，遣明州水軍三百戍昆山黃魚垛，巡捕槽船之為盜者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: three hundred Mingzhou naval troops garrisoned Huangyu duo at Kunshan to hunt canal grain-boat pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuyin: 300 Mingzhou sailors garrisoned Kunshan Huangyu duo against canal-boat pirates.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔諸路帥司，春秋教閱禁兵弓弩手。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an edict ordered circuit commanders to drill forbidden-army crossbowmen in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, circuit commanders were ordered to drill forbidden-army crossbowmen each spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以葉義問知樞密院，翰林學士周麟之同知院事，御史中丞朱倬參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Ye Yiwen was made Privy Council commissioner; Hanlin academician Zhou Linsi co-commissioner; and Investigating Censor-in-Chief Zhu Zhuo participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Ye Yiwen became Privy Council commissioner, Zhou Linsi co-commissioner, and Censor-in-Chief Zhu Zhuo participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingwu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賀允中使還，言金人必叛盟，宜為之備。

translations.literal: Day renzi: He Yunzhong returned from his mission and said the Jin would surely break the treaty and preparations should be made.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, He Yunzhong returned reporting the Jin would break the treaty and urging preparations.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，允中致仕。

translations.literal: Day guichou: He Yunzhong retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, He Yunzhong retired.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復以四川經、總製錢五十萬緡給總領所，增招兵士。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: another five hundred thousand strings from Sichuan general and circuit treasury funds were given the Chief Fiscal Office to recruit more troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, another 500,000 strings of Sichuan general and circuit treasury funds went to the Chief Fiscal Office to raise troops.

sentences.zh: 壬申，淮東總管許世安奏，金主亮至汴京，起重兵五十余萬，屯宿、泗州，謀來攻。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Huaidong overall commander Xu Shi'an memorialized that Jin ruler Liang had reached Bianjing, raised more than five hundred thousand troops, and encamped at Su and Si prefectures planning attack.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Huaidong commander Xu Shi'an reported Jin ruler Liang at Bianjing with 500,000-plus troops at Su and Si, poised to attack.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，以帶禦器械李寶為浙西副總管，提督海船，駐平江。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: Palace Equipage Office member Li Bao was made Zhexi deputy overall commander to oversee sea ships, stationed at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: Li Bao of the Palace Equipage Office became Zhexi deputy overall commander over sea ships at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命劉寶招制勝軍千人。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Liu Bao was ordered to recruit one thousand Victorious Army troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Bao was ordered to raise 1,000 Victorious Army troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷內侍省。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Eunuch Bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Eunuch Bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，罷內侍官承受諸軍奏報文字。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: eunuch officials receiving military memorial texts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingwu: eunuch intake of military memorials was ended.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣虞允文使金賀正旦，徐度賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Yu Yunwen was sent to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Xu Du was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yu Yunwen was sent to the Jin for New Year greetings and Xu Du for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，雷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, thunder.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，鎮江都統制劉寶以專悍貪橫罷。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Zhenjiang overall commander Liu Bao was dismissed for domineering brutality and greedy excess.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhenjiang commander Liu Bao was dismissed for bullying greed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以劉錡為鎮江都統制，荊南右軍統制李道為都統制。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Liu Qi was made Zhenjiang overall commander, and Jingnan right-army controller Li Dao overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Liu Qi became Zhenjiang commander and Li Dao, Jingnan right-army controller, overall commander.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，日中無雲而雷。

translations.literal: Day guihai: at midday, without clouds, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, thunder sounded at noon under a cloudless sky.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠲舒、和、蘄、黃四州民附種田租。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: attached-cultivation field rent for the people of Shu, He, Qi, and Huang four prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, attached-field rent was forgiven in Shu, He, Qi, and Huang.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，禁諸路折輸職田錢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen: circuit commutation of office-field money was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengchen: circuits were forbidden to commute office-field payments.

sentences.zh: 癸已夜，有白氣出入危、昴間。

translations.literal: On the night of guisi, white vapor moved in and out between the Wei and Mao constellations.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi night: white vapor passed between Wei and Mao.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，湯思退罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi new moon: Tang Situi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi new moon: Tang Situi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 初行會子于東南。

translations.literal: Huizi notes were first circulated in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Huizi government notes were first issued in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 戊申夜，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the night of wushen, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Wushen night: white vapor spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 海南黎賊王文滿平。

translations.literal: The Hainan Li bandit Wang Wenman was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hainan Li rebel Wang Wenman was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷招刺三衙及江上諸軍。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: recruitment in the Three Palace offices and the river armies was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, recruiting for the Three Palace offices and river armies ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁掠賣生口入溪峒。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: selling people as slaves into stream gorges was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, selling people into gorge slavery was banned.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命戶部立經、總製錢十年中數為定額。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the Revenue Bureau was ordered to fix general and circuit treasury quotas at the ten-year median.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Revenue Bureau set general and circuit treasury quotas to ten-year medians.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，金遣僕散權等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Jin sent Pusan Quan and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Jin sent Pusan Quan and others for the coming New Year.
